notes_for_editor: Record county is null; the Forest Lookouts Florida index gives Nassau County (cited), so consider filling county. Other names in use: 'Hilliard Forestry Station' (Flickr caption) and 'Hilliard W.C.' (index); consider other_names, not a correction. The Flickr photo (6 Feb 2023, Earl C. Leatherberry) is marked all rights reserved, so it is not added to photos. The LocalGovs listing's 'founded in 2010' is a directory field and was not used. Florida Memory (state archive) item pages returned 403 to the fetch tool and may hold older photos or history. No built date, height, design, staffing or present state found; the tower's existence rests on the 2023 caption only. Whether visitors may climb it is unknown; check with the Florida Forest Service before any visit. Not in the NHLR or FFLOS Florida lists checked.
